Trial courts: superior (felonies, divorce, land), state, juvenile, probate (wills, marriage licenses) and magistrate (warrants, small claims). Judges are chosen in nonpartisan elections — no party label on the ballot. When a seat opens early, the governor appoints a judge. Dual purpose: interpret what the laws mean, and administer justice by deciding cases fairly.
